statement: The nightly formation-health workflow produces measuring verdicts and a committed trend: an UNKNOWN verdict fails the job loudly and appends nothing, every measuring run (green or red) appends one record to data/formation-health/trend.ndjson and commits it to main with the workflow token, and the release notes, the README claim and the consolidation budget read that committed file; done when three consecutive scheduled records measure.

constraints.statement: The probe and the change live in the existing formation-health owner and workflow; no script or workflow is added (epic rule 2026-09-13).
An UNKNOWN verdict is a failed run, never a trend record.
A measuring red verdict is committed like a green one; the trend is evidence, not a pass list.
